propositions: Plan review operations that complete with a PASS verdict must sign and persist a plan-review attestation by default at every mutating public boundary (CLI review-plan command and library review_plan function), unless explicitly opted out with --no-sign or sign=False.
Deliberate unsigned execution requires explicit opt-out: CLI exposes --no-sign flag; library exposes sign=False parameter; omitting either defaults to signing.
BLOCK, INDETERMINATE, degraded, local-source, and other non-signable verdicts remain unsigned regardless of the sign parameter; signing guards are enforced at the shared finalization seam.
Re-running a plan review with a current claim-valid attestation reuses it without re-invoking the LLM or emitting duplicate signature events.
A PASS verdict with signature-persistence failure returns a retryable nonzero disposition and identifies sign-review as the recovery path rather than reporting success.
